item.title: Avalanche search for answers as power-play woes continue
item.description: It's pretty safe to assume the Colorado Avalanche aren't going to "fix" the power play with only one game left for the 2026 Winter Olympics break.

item.title: Janine Sonis got the trade she wanted to land with Summit FC, where she finally gets to play with longtime friend, rival Lindsey Heaps
item.description: For months, Janine Sonis was the keeper of Colorado's biggest soccer secret.

item.title: Judge: Deal reached to protect identities of Epstein victims in documents release
item.description: Nearly 100 victims were harmed by sloppy redactions to a massive release of Epstein documents.

item.title: Confident CU Buffs to host No. 20 West Virginia
item.description: Coaches always hope their teams can show improvement as a season goes along. As the Colorado women’s basketball team progresses through its season, coach JR Payne is seeing evidence of that improvement.

item.title: Patriots WR Trent Sherfield is still mentoring Broncos’ Pat Bryant after Bryant took his job
item.description: Two months after the Broncos surprisingly cut bait with Trent Sherfield midseason, though, the veteran receiver wishes no ill will. It's hard to, in the position he's in.

item.title: Colorado football won’t play in Northwestern’s renovated stadium for Week 3 game
item.description: Colorado won’t get a chance to play in Northwestern’s renovated stadium this year.

item.title: Two women attacked in Speer, Platt Park neighborhoods, Denver police say
item.description: Denver police are looking for a man or men suspected of attacking two women in the city’s Speer and Platt Park neighborhoods in January, officials said.

item.title: Keeler: Denver Summit FC set to crush women’s sports record next month — and the team’s not done peaking
item.description: Rob Cohen and the Summit ownership group -- which includes Colorado icons Mikaela Shiffrin and Peyton Manning — aspire to only one class: First. All the way. Top to bottom.

item.title: Nuggets sit out Spencer Jones, play without a power forward in loss to Pistons
item.description: Why Spencer Jones was a healthy scratch against the Pistons on Tuesday despite Aaron Gordon being out with an injury.
